markdown:
## The SDR Engine

Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) generate the pipeline that fuels revenue growth. Companies with high-performing SDR teams create 3x more pipeline per dollar than those relying on marketing alone.

### SDR Hiring Profile

The ideal SDR candidate:

- 0-3 years of professional experience
- Coachable and eager to learn
- Resilient (handles rejection well)
- Competitive (motivated by goals and recognition)
- Articulate communicator (written and verbal)
- Organized and process-oriented

### Where Top SDRs Come From

| Background | Success Rate | Strengths |
|---|---|---|
| Recent college grads (any major) | 60% | Energy, coachability, ambition |
| Retail/hospitality | 65% | Customer interaction, resilience |
| Athletes | 70% | Competitiveness, discipline, teamwork |
| Teachers | 55% | Communication, patience, structure |
| Military | 70% | Discipline, process orientation, resilience |
| Career changers | 50% | Motivation, diverse perspective |

### SDR Compensation Design

| Component | Structure | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Base salary | $45K-$60K | Living wage, attract candidates |
| Monthly bonus | $500-$2,000 | Meeting/opportunity targets |
| Quarterly accelerator | 1.5-2x rate above target | Reward over-performance |
| Promotion bonus | $2K-$5K | Incentivize AE promotion |
| SPIFs | $50-$200 per qualifying activity | Drive specific behaviors |

### The 90-Day SDR Onboarding

| Week | Focus | Activities |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Company and product | Product training, ICP review, tool setup |
| 2 | Process and messaging | Playbook review, call/email scripts, practice |
| 3 | Shadowing and practice | Listen to calls, role-play, first outreach |
| 4 | Ramp targets (50%) | Own outreach, daily coaching, pipeline building |
| 5-8 | Ramp targets (75%) | Increasing volume, refining technique |
| 9-12 | Full quota | Full expectations, advanced training |

### SDR Metrics

| Metric | Average | Top Performer |
|---|---|---|
| Daily activities (calls + emails) | 60-80 | 100+ |
| Connect rate | 5-8% | 10-15% |
| Meetings set per month | 12-15 | 25+ |
| Meeting-to-opportunity rate | 40-50% | 65%+ |
| Pipeline generated per month | $150K-$250K | $400K+ |

### SDR-to-AE Promotion Path

The SDR role should have a clear promotion path:

- Timeline : 12-18 months as SDR
- Criteria : Consistent quota attainment (3+ months above target)
- Preparation : AE shadowing, closing training, account management skills
- Transition : 30-day ramp with mentor AE

### Common SDR Team Mistakes

- Hiring only for experience : Attitude and coachability matter more
- Inadequate training : Throwing SDRs into calls without preparation
- Unrealistic ramp : Expecting full performance in month 1
- No promotion path : SDRs leave if they cannot see advancement
- Measuring activity over outcomes : 100 bad calls beats 50 good ones?
